problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Why the settings and schema don't make a node that can read records - the error the node would refuse to start with. The statements are empty when there is one.

poll.title: Poll
poll.description: Finds the records at the Waiting Status, in order, up to Records per Poll.

read.title: Read
read.description: Reads one record: the status table's row, then each data table's rows, in the order they are sent.

mark.title: Mark
mark.description: Sets a sent record to the Processing Status, while it is still Waiting.

fail.title: Fail
fail.description: Sets a record that couldn't be read to the Failed Status, while it is still Waiting.

400.description: Not a Database source node, or not a database schema for its database
